notes.title: Arenas
notes.body: Every difficulty now has its own arena with its own hazard: the Scrapyard (Difficulty 1), the Rust Factory with conveyor belts that carry you (2), the Toxic Swamp with acid pits that eat your health (3), the Frozen Yard with slippery ice (4) and the Lava Foundry with burning lava cracks (5). Hazards hit enemies too, so lure the horde in. Each arena has its own floor and props.

notes.title: Shield fix
notes.body: Bulwark's shield ring now sits around the character instead of below it.

notes.title: Special abilities
notes.body: Every chassis now has a special ability: Scavver gets bonus scrap every 25th kill, Bulwark's shield blocks a hit after 5s unharmed, Overclocker's overheats end in a fiery heat vent, Magnet fires a magnetic pulse every 6s that shoves enemies and bullets away, and Tinker drops a turret every 12s. Your playtime and achievements now show in the HELIX Launcher. Shop tooltips now hide when you move the mouse away. Pickup Range buffs are gone (Magnet Coil gives Scrap Gain instead).

notes.title: Achievements
notes.body: 24 achievements to unlock, from your first kill to beating stage 20 on Difficulty 5. They pop up the moment you earn them and save automatically. See them all, with progress bars, from the new ACHIEVEMENTS button on the title screen. Your earlier kills, runs and best stage count toward them.

notes.title: Tutorial and auto-save
notes.body: New TUTORIAL on the title screen: a guided practice run that teaches movement, auto-fire, scrap, spawn markers, heat, elites, level-ups and the shop. Progress now saves automatically as you play: unlocks like new chassis and difficulties are saved the moment you earn them, even if you quit mid-run. Your launcher name shows on the title and results screens.

notes.title: The new look
notes.body: All-new cartoon art: new chassis, enemies, all five bosses (Scrap Spider redrawn), floor and props. Redesigned UI with a new font, buttons and logo. Every item has its own icon, every weapon its own gun, and new projectiles and effects. Torch Sprayer now shoots fireballs and Frost Coil ice shards.

notes.title: 20-stage runs and difficulties
notes.body: Runs are now 20 stages with a boss on stage 20. Beat it to unlock the next difficulty (1 to 5), and every difficulty has its own, harder boss: Scrap Spider, Void Eye, Sludge King, Bone Crusher and Horned Overseer. Higher difficulties bring tougher, harder-hitting, smarter enemies, faster spawns, more elites and longer stages, while the shop and prices stay the same. Your unlocked danger levels carry over as difficulties.

notes.title: Enemies that match your build
notes.body: Enemies and bosses now read your build: the stronger your weapons and stats, the tougher they get, so no build can one-shot everything or melt a boss in seconds. Bosses always take a real fight (35 to 55 seconds of your damage) and each one hits harder and attacks faster than the last. Stats have diminishing returns past a soft cap (shown in gold) and lower maximums, items have stack limits, and harvesting grows slower. Overheating now works properly: the bar drains all the way to empty at your Cooling rate before heat builds again, with the heat bonus off until then.

notes.title: Shifting scrapyard
notes.body: The debris (crates, barrels, tires, rocks) now lands in new random spots at the start of every stage, so it keeps getting in your way, and later stages have a bit more of it.

notes.title: Bosses, lightning and smarter enemies
notes.body: Bosses now have a 60-second timer: kill them in time or the run is lost. Every boss you beat makes the following stages harder (x2, x3, ...) and 30 seconds longer, without paying more. Enemies get smarter as you go: they cut you off, surround you and lead their shots. New weapon: Storm Coil, chain lightning that jumps between enemies. 10 new items including the Piggy Bank (interest on your saved scrap). Hover your items and weapons in the shop to see what they do. Overheating now cancels the heat damage bonus until the bar is empty, and better items show up gradually instead of all at once.

notes.title: First release on HELIX
notes.body: Chassis selection, shared weapon heat, weapon sets, burn and slow, drones, new enemy roles, elites, danger levels 0-5, unlocks, audio, settings and a pause menu. The economy was rebalanced: fewer but tougher enemies, scarcer scrap, slower levels and much stronger bosses.

games.name: SCRAPFALL
games.description: A scrapyard survival roguelite. Pick a chassis and survive 20 stages of scrap creatures while your weapons fire on their own, turning the scrap they drop into a build. Beat the stage 20 boss to unlock the next difficulty: five difficulties, each with a tougher boss.
games.about:
SCRAPFALL is a top-down survival roguelite set in a scrapyard overrun by living junk. You pick a robot chassis, each with its own special ability, and survive 20 stages of swarming enemies while your weapons aim and fire on their own.

Every enemy drops scrap: spend it in the shop between stages on weapons and items, combine weapons into stronger tiers, build weapon sets, and level up with Overclock upgrades. Watch your heat, dodge the hazards of each arena, and beat the boss on stage 20 within 60 seconds to unlock the next difficulty, each with a tougher boss and a new arena.

Features: 5 chassis with special abilities, 11 weapons, 48 items, 5 bosses, 5 arenas with their own hazards, 24 achievements and a full tutorial.

notes.title: Icarus: Crispy Feathers
notes.body: Icarus joins the HELIX Launcher! A 3D platformer collectathon by Antique.

games.name: Icarus: Crispy Feathers
games.tagline: Flew too close to the sun. Time to get those feathers back.
games.description: A 3D platformer collectathon. Icarus burned his wings right off, and his feathers are scattered across the world: collect them all and gain new movement abilities as you go.
games.about:
Icarus has flown too close to the sun and burned his wings right off! Now all of his feathers are scattered across the world, and he has to collect every last one of them all over again.

Icarus: Crispy Feathers is a 3D platformer collectathon. Explore, hunt down feathers, and gain new movement abilities as you play.

See if you can get them all!

notes.title: Flush You
notes.body: Flush You joins the HELIX Launcher! A two-player fishy brawl made for Concordia's Cosmic Jam.

games.name: Flush You
games.tagline: A two-player fishy brawl. Whatever you do, don't get flushed.
games.description: An arcade brawler for two players. Battle a friend while obstacles and toiletries rain down, grab power-ups for the upper hand, and be the last fish standing before the flush.
games.about:
Play against a friend in this arcade-style fishy brawl! Dodge the obstacles and toiletries falling from above, collect power-ups to get the advantage, and whatever you do, don't get flushed!

Flush You was made for Concordia's Cosmic Jam by:
James Van Aelst: gameplay programming, UI programming, game design
Santiago Santos: gameplay programming, UI programming, game design
Joseph Lodico: gameplay programming
Antique (Anthony Vitalei-D'Ermes): music and audio
Mark Benson Galvez: 3D art and illustration
Alexandrine Beaulac: 3D art

notes.title: IVendetta
notes.body: IVendetta joins the HELIX Launcher! A Doom-like arena shooter made in 30 hours for Gamerella 2025.

games.name: IVendetta
games.tagline: They stole your art. Show them a real piece of your work.
games.description: A Doom-like arena shooter. Play as Nightshade, an artist whose work was stolen by an AI data center: blast its AI units with your creative tools, break into every area and destroy all the servers.
games.about:
You're an artist. Your art got stolen by an AI data center. Now you're going to show them a real piece of your work.

In this Doom-like arena shooter you play as Nightshade. Destroy every server in the data center and infect its database with colourful mayhem:
- Pick up your next weapon... er, creative tool.
- Obliterate all the AI units.
- Unlock new areas of the data center.
- Destroy all the servers!

IVendetta was made in 30 hours for Gamerella 2025, on the theme "I made this for you". All the art was made by the team, mostly during the jam.

notes.title: Sentiment
notes.body: Sentiment joins the HELIX Launcher! A psychological horror game made in 48 hours for the Montreal 2026 Behaviour Interactive Game Jam, winner of Best Audio and Participant's Pick.

games.name: Sentiment
games.tagline: You are not alone. Play with headphones.
games.description: A psychological horror game about a dysfunctional family. You play as a little boy trying to take control of a situation far beyond him. Winner of Best Audio and Participant's Pick at the Behaviour Interactive Game Jam.
games.about:
Sentiment is a psychological horror game that delves into the themes of a dysfunctional family. You play as a little boy trying to take control of a situation that is far beyond him.

It is highly recommended to play with headphones!

Made in 48 hours for the Montreal 2026 Behaviour Interactive Game Jam, on the theme "You Are Not Alone", where it won Best Audio and Participant's Pick.

Wolves of the Night (team 13):
Marcel Taveau: game director
Santiago Santos: gameplay, AI and UI programming, QA
James Van Aelst: gameplay programming, VFX, QA
Joseph Lodico: environment modelling
Lorenzo Marquez: UI programming, voice acting
Antique (Anthony Vitalei-D'Ermes): level design, music
Olivia Vitalei-D'Ermes: art, character and environment modelling
Rawlings Oduwa: sound design, gameplay programming
